aboutText: At Perimeter Landscaping, we've been transforming Brunswick gardens for over 5 years, based on Michael St. Our team specialises in creating beautiful, functional outdoor spaces tailored to your needs. We serve Brunswick and nearby suburbs with passion and expertise.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of landscaping services in Brunswick, including garden design, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Our team uses high-quality materials and innovative techniques to create sustainable and beautiful outdoor environments.
